children: Lockheed Martin got a $1.21 billion award to help build missiles for the Army
The contract is a cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity award for Precision Strike Missile Increment 2 Early Operational Capability.
Work locations and funding will be determined with each order. Work is expected to be completed by Sept. 13, 2031.
